name: What are common hidden issues in historic homes that can affect budget?
description: Older properties frequently conceal structural damage, outdated wiring, undersized plumbing, termites, dry rot, and moisture problems behind walls and finishes.

mainEntity.name: What are common hidden issues in historic homes that can affect budget?

acceptedAnswer.text: Older properties frequently conceal structural damage, outdated wiring, undersized plumbing, termites, dry rot, and moisture problems behind walls and finishes. Allowing a contingency in the budget for discoveries during demolition is critical, as investigating and resolving these issues often drives cost and schedule.
